normal.name: Grid Gremlin
normal.text: Hot take: the best part of old multiplayer games was dying first. You got to spectate and narrate everyone else's mistakes. Lightcycle games are perfect for it, since every crash is visible from the overhead view. Which game was most fun to watch after you'd lost? #gaming #retrogaming

normal.name: K~
normal.text: I own a bunch of DOS games from GOG. Unfortunately, all of these are bundled with a Windows version of DOSBox only. I'd like to use a linux version. But which one? Apparently there are two 'modern' versions of DOSBox; called "DOSBox-x" and "DOSBox Staging". I'm wondering if anyone has any experience / recommendations about this. (Otherwise I'll just pick on at random.) #retrogaming #dos #linux #linux_gaming
